List all current Items in the Render Queue.

Delete the media of the Queue Item with UUID. Returns an error when the node is not present in the Queue. (obsolete. Use the PUT method on /application/render/{queue_uuid} with delete_existing_media set to true instead)

summary: Add a new Render Queue Item
description: Add a new Render Queue Item from a Output with UUID and (optionally a frame range). Returns an error is the Output UUID is not found.

summary: Create a new Render Queue Item and start rendering
description: Add a new Render Queue Item from a Output with UUID and (optionally a frame range) and start rendering the item. Returns an error is the Output UUID is not found.

summary: Get the Render Queue Item results
description: Get the list of files rendered from the Render Queue item. If the Queue item has not been rendered, an error is returned.
Start processing the Queue Item with UUID. If delete_existing_media is true, existing media will be deleted before rendering. Returns an error if the UUID does not references a valid output node.
Stop rendering all queue items.
Stop rendering the Queue Item with UUID. Returns an error when the node is not present in the Queue.
Get the status of the Queue Item with UUID. Returns an error is the item is not found.
Update the Queue Item with UUID. Returns an error if the item is not found.
Remove the Item with UUID from the Render Queue. Returns an error if the item is not found.
Restart the application (Windows only).
Shutdown the application.

Copy the grade / custom settings from the Shot with source UUID to the Shot with destination UUID. Optionally, include a source / destination layer indices to copy a grade to / from a specific layer. Use paste_options to control which aspects of the source are copied. When no paste_options are given (or none enabled), the current user selected paste-options are used (as shown in the Paste Options panel in the player).
Generate an image from the Shot with UUID at the specified frame postion, using the default snapshot format settings.

summary: Get LUT of Shot at Frame
description: Get the LUT of the Shot with UUID at the specified frame postion. Support multiple Lut formats, specified in the request body. Returns an error when the shot is not found or can not be created.
